capabilities: create class files with inheritance, composition and aggregation relation links
open the class relation view via command
analyze rendered class relations between class files
show class comments and highlight on cursor hover
extras: README warns the plugin is in development with known bugs, e.g. the rhombus marker for composition/aggregation is often not positioned on the line.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows all note links uniformly and cannot distinguish or lay out class relations like inheritance, composition and aggregation.
summary: Class diagram viewer that reads class files with relation links and renders inheritance, composition and aggregation relations in a dedicated view.
